title: Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors under pull-back and interior product (parent (L0)–(L2))
statement: For all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, writing |α| for covectorEuclideanNorm α (the Euclidean norm of the values of a covector on the strictly increasing tuples of standard basis vectors), |v| for the Euclidean norm and ‖A‖ for the operator norm: (L1) for every continuous linear map A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and every k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}, the pull-back A^#β := β.compContinuousLinearMap A, (A^#β)(w_1, …, w_k) = β(Aw_1, …, Aw_k), satisfies |A^#β| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β|; (L2) for every v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N, the interior product ι_vβ := β.curryLeft v, (ι_vβ)(w_1, …, w_k) = β(v, w_1, …, w_k), satisfies |ι_vβ| ≤ |v|·|β|.
lean_statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β
